snippet.title: Everlast: Undying Tale - Playtest Announcement
snippet.description:
We are hosting a free play test on December 19-21 
Participants who provide feedback have a chance to get a free key on realase!

More info at:
https://www.playeverlast.com/

Join our Discord!
https://discord.com/invite/7cMQwp8MaD

Wish-list on Steam! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3818450/Everlast_Undying_Tale/
